section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single cross-sectional study examining the relationship between body appreciation and sexual function in women. Data were collected online from 247 women aged 18-58, and the study found that body appreciation was modestly negatively correlated with BMI and predicted arousal, orgasm, and satisfaction aspects of sexual function after controlling for sexual orientation, partner status, and age.
